mapper.sql: r.id AS run_id,r.policy_id,r.policy_row_version,r.rule_release_id,r.rule_row_version,r.snapshot_hash,r.catalog_hash, r.execution_code_hash,r.runtime_hash,r.expected_case_count,r.maximum_requests,r.maximum_bytes,r.request_reservations,r.reserved_bytes, r.run_status_code,r.row_version,r.requested_by,r.idempotency_key,r.request_hash,r.created_at,r.expires_at,r.completed_at, b.plan_hash,b.segment_no,b.segment_count,b.catalog_case_count,b.executable_case_count,b.is_expectation_coverage_complete,b.maximum_seconds_including_margin, (p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND p.row_version=r.policy_row_version AND p.rule_release_id=r.rule_release_id AND t.row_version=r.rule_row_version AND t.release_status_code IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')) AS input_versions_current

FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=r.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases t ON t.id=r.rule_release_id LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_provider_qa_run_plans b ON b.run_id=r.id
mapper.insert: -- 승인한 서버 계획을 run/case/READY와 같은 transaction에 봉인한다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_provider_qa_run_plans(run_id,plan_hash,segment_no,segment_count,catalog_case_count, executable_case_count,is_expectation_coverage_complete,maximum_seconds_including_margin) VALUES(#{runId},#{planHash},#{segmentNo},#{segmentCount},#{catalogCaseCount},#{executableCaseCount},#{expectationCoverageComplete},#{maximumSecondsIncludingMargin})
mapper.select: -- 이전 V79 이력도 보존한다. 인증 정보는 Service의 안전한 응답 DTO로 제한한다. SELECT WHERE r.id=#{runId}
-- 같은 키의 actor/정책/입력을 검사하며 네트워크 재실행은 하지 않는다. SELECT WHERE r.idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 정책에 속한 전체 실행 분모다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs WHERE policy_id=#{policyId}

-- 원문/증거 JSON/lease token을 조회 응답에 포함하지 않는다. SELECT id AS case_id,ordinal,case_code,input_hash,profile_hash,expected_file_count,case_status_code,row_version, request_reservations,reserved_bytes,started_at,completed_at,error_code,evidence_hash FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 성공 항목만 세지 않고 미실행/실패를 포함한 전체 분모를 반환한다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases WHERE run_id=#{runId}

-- 전역 활성 원장 1개 제약과 같은 범위다. queue lock 아래 정리/예약에 사용한다. SELECT id FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs WHERE run_status_code IN ('BUILDING','READY','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY created_at,id

-- 같은 키 재조회는 이 검사보다 먼저 처리한다. 실패/취소도 새 예약 간격에 포함한다. SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs WHERE policy_id=#{policyId} AND created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')
-- 이미 실행한 항목은 재claim하지 않는다. SELECT id FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND case_status_code='PENDING' ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 1
mapper.update: -- 현재 입력과 불일치한 미실행 항목만 종료한다. 실행 중인 소유자의 자원은 건드리지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c SET case_status_code='FAILED',error_code='INPUT_CHANGED',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=c.row_version+1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r WHERE r.id=c.run_id AND r.id=#{runId} AND r.run_status_code IN ('READY','RUNNING') AND c.case_status_code='PENDING'
